summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of TipJar iteration-2 features (referral rewards, dev-mode email verification, EUR credit economics, centered invite section, verify-email banner, /verify page). All 38 pytest cases pass. All requested frontend flows verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Displays untranslated i18n keys instead of localized text. Shows literally 'verify.success', 'verify.done', 'verify.home' on the success screen and 'verify.fail', 'verify.home' on the failure screen. The success/failure logic and data-testid='verify-page' are correct; only the translation strings are missing from the i18n dictionary.

Shows raw i18n keys 'invite.reward' (below subtitle, visible in the centered invite card) and 'invite.loginToEarn' (small text below the invite link when logged out) instead of localized text. Other invite.* keys (title, subtitle, badge, copy, goal, members, msg, copied) render correctly, so only 'invite.reward' and 'invite.loginToEarn' are missing from the i18n dictionary.

action_items: Add missing i18n strings for keys: 'verify.success', 'verify.done', 'verify.home', 'verify.fail', 'invite.reward', 'invite.loginToEarn' in the i18n dictionary (en/de/el) so the /verify page and the landing InviteSection show real localized copy instead of raw keys.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1014 lines — past the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/modules: auth (register/login/me/profile/verify/resend), tips (analyze/create/list/rate/status), credits (packages/checkout/webhook/gift/redeem), notifications, admin/settle. Same suggestion carried over from iteration-1 and is now more warranted.

In send_verification_email(), the origin parameter is treated as free-form and only trailing '/' is stripped. Consider validating that inp.origin_url starts with an allowed scheme (http/https) to prevent malicious verify links being embedded in the (currently dev-only) response payload once Resend is enabled.

verify-email endpoint always deletes the token at the end, even for the branch where user.email_verified is already true (no reward). Correct behavior, but consider adding an audit trail (referral credit_transactions is already inserted — good).

credits/checkout stores currency='eur' correctly, but there is no server-side validation that inp.origin_url is trusted; a malicious client could set success/cancel URLs to arbitrary hosts. Consider whitelisting.

REDEEM_EUR_PER_1000 math is correct (€5 per 1000), but redeem() resets received_credits to 0 unconditionally; if the redemption is later rejected by an admin, credits are lost. Consider a two-phase 'requested' -> 'paid'/'rejected' with balance restoration on rejection.
Frontend: verify-page and invite-section have missing translation keys (see ui_bugs) — the raw key strings are user-visible.

Frontend: no visible rate-limit or loading-state protection on the 'Resend email' button — repeated clicks will insert many verification tokens for the same user. Consider disabling for 30s after click.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (expanded with 10 new test cases: referral flow with reward validation, invalid/self-referral, resend-verification dev+already-verified, admin grandfathered email_verified, stats shape, redeem<10k error, settle-idle-without-key, EUR-currency checkout, updated package assertions to starter=1000/€10, pro=5000/€50, whale=10000/€100)

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (invite section centered + logged-out/in link + share buttons + copy-invite + member-count; signup -> verify banner + resend button; wallet Buy €10/€50/€100 + Redeem 10k/€50/half messaging; /verify?token=valid shows verify-page success branch; /verify?token=bad shows failure branch). Cosmetic i18n text issues do not block flows.

test_credentials: Admin admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! verified working. E2E test users created dynamically with TEST_/e2e_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed disposable TEST_-prefixed users A and B (session-scoped) plus additional users inside TestReferralAndVerify for isolated referral scenarios. Admin is seeded by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To rerun backend: `cd /app && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. New tests are in TestReferralAndVerify, TestStatsAndRedeem, TestSettleIdle classes. Dev-mode email verify path relies on register/resend-verification responses including a `verify_link` field — this is the intended test path per problem statement (RESEND_API_KEY not set). Referral reward is exactly 100 credits and is granted only once (referral_rewarded flag). Frontend verify page selector: [data-testid='verify-page']; verify-banner selector: [data-testid='verify-banner']; invite section selectors: invite-section/member-count/invite-link/copy-invite/share-whatsapp/share-telegram/share-x. All present and functional.
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. Only UI polish gaps: (1) 6 i18n translation keys (verify.success, verify.done, verify.home, verify.fail, invite.reward, invite.loginToEarn) are not defined in the translation dictionary, so raw keys leak to the UI. Fix: add these keys with proper English/German/Greek copy in the i18n resource. Reproduction: navigate to /verify?token=<valid> — success page shows literal 'verify.success', 'verify.done', 'verify.home' instead of localized text; navigate to /verify?token=BADTOKEN — failure page shows 'verify.fail', 'verify.home'; scroll to Invite section on landing — 'invite.reward' shows as raw key, and if logged out, 'invite.loginToEarn' also shows as raw key.
